name: agent-task
description: Written with the agent-task form; not approval for agents (that is agent-ready)

name: agent-ready
description: Triaged spec: an agent may take it. Set by a maintainer or the maintenance routine, not a template

name: agent-working
description: An agent has claimed this issue (the claim comment names the branch)

name: agent-pr
description: Pull request opened by an agent

name: awaiting-approval
description: PR is green and waits for the maintainer's approval (T2/T3) or a review PASS at its tip

name: self-test
description: Filed by the product self-test routine (issues only)

name: needs-info
description: Waiting for the reporter or a maintainer decision

name: needs-human
description: The agent loop stopped; a person must decide (reason in the last comment)

name: hold
description: A person froze this issue or PR; agents and automation leave it alone

name: risk:T0
description: Risk tier T0 (docs only), set by the controller from the diff; never by hand

name: risk:T1
description: Risk tier T1 (client, tests, generated files), set by the controller from the diff

name: risk:T2
description: Risk tier T2 (host/plugin code or an unnamed path), set by the controller from the diff

name: risk:T3
description: Risk tier T3 (needs a human approval), set by the controller from the diff
